call_points.text: Tax rate expected to normalise at around 25% for coming quarters after the deferred-tax reversal.
Peptide manufacturing capacity with end-to-end solid-phase synthesis to complete commissioning by end of FY27.
Three NCE CDMO programs in advanced phases to commercialise in FY28.
More than 25 NCE programs in API division, with 3 in late stage.
Aflibercept on track for India launch in FY27, partnered with three Indian companies.
Nivolumab India clinical study started; launch targeted for FY28.
Regulatory pathway is the main risk that could slow growth, the CFO said.
Unicycive partner received a CRL from USFDA and plans to refile in Q3.
No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management said it has grown healthily for 2-3 years and expects the trajectory to continue.
FY26 capex was ₹361 Cr, funded by internal accruals; no significant capex growth expected over last year.
Net debt rose to ₹613 Cr from ₹550 Cr; interest cost has stabilised at the current quarterly run rate.
Europe formulations revenue crossed ₹200 Cr, more than doubling YoY; Rotigotine launches in FY27 with ramp-up in FY28.
Biologics revenue was ₹150 Cr in FY26, roughly doubling; FY27 growth to come mainly from CDMO and biosimilar licensing.
OLC block commissioned in Q4FY26; validation batches planned in Q1FY27, but no meaningful OLC contribution expected in FY27.
Albumin IMPD submission moved to first half of FY27 from Q4 as batches are run at the new facility.
Jadcherla USFDA audit observations are being remediated; company awaits re-audit and says it has no revenue impact.
Raw material and solvent availability is fine, but prices have risen significantly.
Adjusted ROCE excluding biologics and albumin investments rose from 4% in FY23 to 17.4% in FY26.
API CDMO business was about ₹110 Cr for FY26, with a similar-sized CDMO business on the biologics side.
Adalimumab and NorUDCA Europe revenues are expected only in FY29; NorUDCA ROW revenue from FY28.

operating_notes.text: API CDMO revenue was about ₹110 Cr in FY26, with a similar-sized CDMO business in biologics.
Europe formulations revenue exceeded ₹200 Cr in FY26, more than doubling YoY.
Five active CDMO and NBE programs are ongoing, with Phase I clinical batches for one innovator program initiated in Q4FY26.
Formulation captive sourcing from own API is more than 50%.
More than 20 CDMO customers across the Shilpa Group.
Only one product is commercial on the CDMO side, with more than 25 NCE programs in development.

timeline.summary: On its 22 May 2026 Q4FY26 call, Shilpa Medicare reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,549 Cr (+18%) and EBITDA of ₹445 Cr (+30%), with net debt at ₹613 Cr and no numeric FY27 guidance.

On 10 August 2026, Shilpa Medicare filed the transcript of its Q1FY27 call, where management reported revenue of ₹469 Cr (+43% YoY) and PAT of ₹101 Cr (+115% YoY), helped by a deferred-tax reversal, and guided to a ~25% tax rate ahead.
